title: Physics Lab runtime canonical recipe closed shape
objective: Close the retained PhysicsLabRuntime canonical-recipe container-shape gap after #408 lands: reject extra top-level recipe fields, extra entity-recipe wrapper fields, and any non-exact key/index on recipe.entities while preserving bounded malformed-input work and all accepted runtime transaction/identity invariants.
acceptance: top-level Physics Lab recipe is an exact plain closed record: only schemaVersion, recipeKey, worldId, regionId, and entities are accepted
each entity-recipe wrapper is an exact plain closed record containing only key and entity

recipe.entities is an exact dense array with only integer keys 1..canonicalEntityCount; reject string keys, zero/negative/noninteger indices, sparse/high indices, or any extra entry outside the canonical population
closed-shape validation is bounded by project-owned schema/population size: stop after at most allowedCount+1 observed keys rather than scanning arbitrarily many malformed caller keys
reject malformed container shape before registry/Fidelity authority construction and without executing metatable/stringification hooks

add deterministic adversaries for one extra top-level field, one extra entity-wrapper field, one entities string key, sparse/high numeric key, zero/negative/noninteger key, and many-extra-key input; verify immediate canonical retry remains valid

preserve #408 canonical value/provenance/state/revision checks, WorldEntityId lookup fence, closure-private weak-key state, frozen facade, whole-step transaction fence, callback unwind/retry, and exact source-only evidence boundaries
canonical CI and engine-tests required; fresh independent exact-head review required; trusted live pr-ownership remains mandatory before integration
no Studio, viewport, physical-contact, or two-client evidence claim
notes: Proposed from capacity-mining finding evt-20260812t090530z-r7m4k9q2-physics-runtime-recipe-shape against independently reviewed retained synthesis #408 head d31c100c5d3766ca14d89b046fff4cdb09086754. #408 correctly closes nested WorldEntity record/origin shapes and canonical value/state/provenance identity, but top-level recipe, entity-recipe wrappers, and the entities container itself can silently carry extra plain-data keys outside the fields/prefix actually read.
